items.title: D-Wave Stock Sinks as Earnings Lay Bare Quantum’s Commercial Growing Pains
items.summary: D-Wave Quantum tops revenue estimates for the third quarter, but a drop in system sales and widening losses send the stock tumbling,

items.title: Pete Hegseth Might Get Impeached. What That Means for Defense Stocks.
items.summary: Monday, Kentucky Representative Thomas Massie introduced articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

items.title: Democrats Take Congress: 4 Dividend Stocks From Oil to Telecom Worth Buying
items.summary: With Democrats holding Congress and a Republican in the White House, gridlock looms for Washington. Four dividend payers span oil, defense, real estate, and telecom, and each one's cash flow looks built to shrug off the stalemate. One is vulnerable to a very different threat.

items.title: The Pentagon Offers Rocket Lab a $150 Million Loan to Speed Up Its Neutron Rocket
items.summary: Washington just backed Rocket Lab's reusable rocket with fresh money, but the rocket has yet to leave the ground. A flawed tank dome, a slipping debut, and a shaky earnings picture raise the question of what this loan can really fix.

items.title: Why Lockheed Martin Rallied in October
items.summary: Strong earnings, along with visibility into longer-term F-35 and missile demand, pushed shares higher.

items.title: NASA Says Bezos’ Blue Origin Can Compete For Up to $10 Billion in Moon Base Contracts, As Musk’s SpaceX Soars
items.summary: Eight companies just split a $10 billion ceiling that NASA has not spent a dime of, yet lunar stocks jumped double digits overnight. Who is the market betting on, and what has it already priced in?

items.title: SpaceX, Blue Origin Winners As NASA Awards $10 Bil In Moon Base Contracts
items.summary: NASA over the weekend awarded major contracts to SpaceX, Blue Origin, Lockheed Martin and more for its Moon Base efforts. Space stocks surged.

items.title: Why Voyager Technologies Stock Went to the Moon on Monday
items.summary: A new NASA contract could be worth $10 billion -- or $15 billion -- to Voyager Technologies (and others).
